std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t ============================================================================\n\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n                if (i == j) continue;\n\n                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n\n                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n\n                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n            }\n\n            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n        }\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {\n    printf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            printf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    printf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    printf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        printf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    int nonZeroKij = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;\n    }\n    printf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,\n           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        printf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    printf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    printf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    printf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    printf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    printf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    printf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    printf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Initialize\n    SimulationState state;\n    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Precomputation\n    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeTimeDelays(state);\n    computeFormFactors(state);\n\n    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n    printf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Simulation\n    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    runSimulation(state);\n\n    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n    printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Distance computation\n    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n    computeDistances(state);\n\n    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();\n\n    printf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n\n    // Total time\n    long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n    printf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n    // Performance metrics\n    size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n    double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n    double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);\n    double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);\n\n    printf(\"\\nPerformance:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  Triangles: %zu\\n\", n);\n    printf(\"  Timesteps: %zu\\n\", t);\n    printf(\"  Form factor computations: %.2e\\n\", kijOps);\n    printf(\"  Simulation operations: %.2e\\n\", simOps);\n    printf(\"  Distance computations: %.2e\\n\", distOps);\n    printf(\"  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\\n\", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);\n\n    // Memory usage\n    size_t memKij = n * n * sizeof(val_t);\n    size_t memTau = n * n * sizeof(int);\n    size_t memRad = 2 * t * n * sizeof(val_t);\n    size_t totalMem = memKij + memTau + memRad;\n    printf(\"  Memory usage: %.2f MB\\n\", totalMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));\n\n    // Hash\n    uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);\n    printf(\"  Result hash: %016lX\\n\", hash);\n    printf(\"\\n\");\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Convert distances to double for output\n        std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());\n        print_results(distData, \"Distances\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        if (!validateResults(state)) {\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n","numLines":949,"startLine":1,"totalLines":949}},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01NunHvpiuNgiaUw844FtoML","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n { return dist(rng); }\n};\n\n// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\nVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n    val_t u = {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfytmjUdaNYMLMPfsDpqE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The roomsim benchmark now runs its hot loops in parallel with OpenMP, and its output hash is bit-identical to the original sequential program. The 5120-triangle run takes 3.4–3.8 s instead of 471 s.\n\n**What changed**\n\n- **`roomsim/roomsim.cpp`**\n  - **Form factors (the dominant cost):** the original draws every random number from one sequential `mt19937` stream, so per-thread RNGs would change the results. Instead, a producer walks the rows in order, snapshots the RNG state at each row's start, and skips past the draws that row consumes. Workers compute rows in parallel from those snapshots as they're published, so the RNG stream is the same as before.\n  - **Time delays, per-timestep propagation, and cross-correlation:** parallelized over rows. Each timestep only reads radiosity from earlier timesteps (`tau >= 1` for distinct triangles), so rows within a timestep are independent.\n  - Includes `<omp.h>` unconditionally; there are no `#ifdef` guards.\n- **`roomsim/CMakeLists.txt`:** `find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)` and links `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`. The executable name is unchanged, and no files were created in the repo.\n\n**Choices you may want to review**\n\n- The header now prints an extra line, `OpenMP threads: N`.\n- Form-factor progress lines appear in completion order rather than strictly by row index, since rows finish out of order.\n- The producer holds one RNG snapshot per row, about 2.5 KB × N triangles (roughly 51 MB at N=20480).\n\n**Verification**\n\n- Built with CMake in `/tmp`; no warnings with `-Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic`.\n- Compared against a reference build of the original source:\n  - Result hashes match at 1, 8, 16, 64, 128, and 256 threads.\n  - Sizes 320, 1280, and 5120 match, including the `-s`, `-r`, and `-t` variants I tried.\n  - `-v` validation passes in every case.\n- Timings (`-n 1280 -t 50`):\n  - Serial original: 26.6 s.\n  - 128–256 threads: about 0.23–0.25 s, roughly 100× faster.\n  - `-n 5120 -t 50`: 471 s serial versus 3.4–3.8 s at 256 threads.\n\nThe 256-thread run looked anomalous at first (a simulation phase jumped from 5 ms to 383 ms). It turned out to be the still-running serial reference job occupying a core on this 256-CPU machine; re-measured on an idle machine, scaling is monotonic.\n\nNot parallelized: allocating and zeroing the N×N `kij` and `tau` matrices, and the octree build, which are small relative to the form-factor work."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":791,"cache_read_input_tokens":67405,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":791},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"674ebf17-6c71-46c5-8ac5-2295a9dcea2f","uuid":"b46a27d5-3675-4e1a-b195-34a94fd94d44","timestamp":"2026-10-13T08:07:44.386Z","request_id":"req_011Cfytmj7Z7Vh5jwPGjFHPp"}
